CancelSpecReviewTask.description_en: Call the CancelSpecReviewTask operation to revoke an approval ticket for an Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch Serverless application specification
CancelSpecReviewTask.description_zh: 调用CancelSpecReviewTask接口，撤销ES Serverless应用规格审批工单

CreateApp.description_en: To create an Elasticsearch Serverless application, call the CreateApp API
CreateApp.description_zh: 调用CreateApp接口，创建Elasticsearch Serverless应用

CreateEndpoint.description_en: Creates a private endpoint for an ES Serverless application. You can create a maximum of 50 private endpoints per region. Only VPC-type endpoints are currently supported, which establish a private connection between your Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) and the ES Serverless service. This operation automatically creates the `AliyunServiceRoleForESServerless` service-linked role if it does not exist
CreateEndpoint.description_zh: 调用CreateEndpoint接口，创建ES Serverless应用的私网终端节点，目前限制用户每个区域最多创建50个。目前仅支持创建VPC类型的端点，用来打通用户VPC网络和ES Serverless服务的网络。调用该接口会默认帮助用户创建AliyunServiceRoleForESServerless角色

CreateSnapshot.description_en: Call CreateSnapshot to create a snapshot for an Elasticsearch Serverless application
CreateSnapshot.description_zh: 调用CreateSnapshot，创建ES Serverless应用的快照

DeleteApp.description_en: Call the DeleteApp operation to delete an Elasticsearch Serverless application
DeleteApp.description_zh: 调用DeleteApp接口，删除Elasticsearch Serverless应用

DeleteDict.description_en: You can call the DeleteDict operation to delete dictionaries for an ES Serverless application
DeleteDict.description_zh: 调用DeleteDict接口，删除ES Serverless应用的词典

DeleteEndpoint.description_en: Call the DeleteEndpoint operation to delete an endpoint from the Elasticsearch Serverless platform
DeleteEndpoint.description_zh: 调用DeleteEndpoint接口，删除在ES Serverless平台创建的终端节点

DeleteSnapshot.description_en: This operation deletes a snapshot of an Elasticsearch Serverless application
DeleteSnapshot.description_zh: 调用DeleteSnapshot接口，删除ES Serverless应用快照

GetApp.description_en: Call the GetApp operation to retrieve details about an Elasticsearch Serverless application
GetApp.description_zh: 调用GetApp接口，获取Elasticsearch Serverless应用的详情信息

GetAppQuota.description_en: Call the GetAppQuota operation to retrieve the quota information for an Elasticsearch Serverless application
GetAppQuota.description_zh: 调用GetAppQuota接口，获取Elasticsearch Serverless应用的配额信息

GetMonitorData.description_en: Call the GetMonitorData API to retrieve metric data for Elasticsearch Serverless Application Monitoring
GetMonitorData.description_zh: 调用GetMonitorData接口，获取Elasticsearch Serverless应用监控的指标数据

GetSnapshotSetting.description_en: Call the GetSnapshotSetting API to retrieve the automatic backup configuration of an ES Serverless application
GetSnapshotSetting.description_zh: 调用GetSnapshotSetting接口，获取ES Serverless应用的自动备份配置

GetSpecReviewTask.description_en: Call the GetSpecReviewTask API to view the details of a specification approval ticket for an ES Serverless application
GetSpecReviewTask.description_zh: 调用GetSpecReviewTask接口，查看ES Serverless应用的规格审批工单详情

ListApps.description_en: Call the ListApps API to retrieve a list of Elasticsearch Serverless applications
ListApps.description_zh: 调用ListApps接口，查看Elasticsearch Serverless应用的列表

ListDicts.description_en: Retrieves a list of dictionaries for an ES Serverless application
ListDicts.description_zh: 调用ListDicts接口，获取ES Serverless应用的词典列表

ListEndpoints.description_en: Call the ListEndpoints operation to retrieve a list of VPC endpoints created on the Elasticsearch Serverless platform
ListEndpoints.description_zh: 调用ListEndpoints接口，获取在ES Serverless平台创建的VPC终端节点列表

ListIndices.description_en: Call the ListIndices operation to view the list of indexes for an ES Serverless application
ListIndices.description_zh: 调用ListIndices接口，查看ES Serverless应用的索引列表

ListSnapshotRepositories.description_en: The ListSnapshotRepositories operation retrieves a list of backup repositories for snapshots of ES Serverless applications
ListSnapshotRepositories.description_zh: 调用ListSnapshotRepositories接口，获取ES Serverless应用快照的备份仓库列表

ListSnapshots.description_en: Call the ListSnapshots operation to retrieve a list of snapshots for an ES Serverless application
ListSnapshots.description_zh: 调用ListSnapshots接口，获取ES Serverless应用的快照列表

ListSpecReviewTasks.description_en: Call ListSpecReviewTasks to retrieve the list of approval tickets for specification changes in an ES Serverless application
ListSpecReviewTasks.description_zh: 调用ListSpecReviewTasks，查看ES Serverless应用中申请修改规格的审批工单列表

UpdateApp.description_en: Call the UpdateApp API to update Elasticsearch Serverless application information, such as remarks, network settings, IP address whitelist groups, and account passwords
UpdateApp.description_zh: 调用UpdateApp接口，更新Elasticsearch Serverless应用相关信息，包括备注、网络开关、IP白名单组、账号密码等

UpdateDict.description_en: Call the UpdateDict operation to create or update a dictionary for an Elasticsearch Serverless application. You can upload dictionaries only from OSS
UpdateDict.description_zh: 调用UpdateDict接口，创建或修改ES Serverless应用词典。目前仅支持通过OSS地址上传

UpdateEndpoint.description_en: Call the UpdateEndpoint operation to modify an endpoint in the ES Serverless platform
UpdateEndpoint.description_zh: 调用UpdateEndpoint接口，修改ES Serverless平台中创建的终端节点

UpdateNetwork.description_en: Update the public network configuration for an application

UpdatePrivateNetwrok.description_en: Updates the private network information of an application

UpdateSnapshotSetting.description_en: The UpdateSnapshotSetting API modifies the automatic backup snapshot configuration for an Elasticsearch Serverless application
UpdateSnapshotSetting.description_zh: 调用UpdateSnapshotSetting接口，修改ES Serverless应用自动备份快照的配置
